acceptance_criteria.requirement: Use a rectangular 50 mm × 35 mm board outline (dimension tolerance 0.1 mm) with two copper layers.
Use a six-pin header J1 with pins 1 through 6 assigned +3V3, GND, BTN1, BTN2, BTN3, BTN4 respectively.

For each channel i from 1 through 4, connect a 10 kohm resistor Ri from +3V3 to BTNi, a 100 nF capacitor Ci from BTNi to GND, and a normally-open momentary switch SWi between BTNi and GND. If a switch has duplicated terminals, map both terminal pairs correctly.

Arrange SW1 through SW4 in a left-to-right row with at least 10 mm centre spacing. Label each switch with its BTN signal. Each button must pull only its own signal to GND when pressed; all four channels share the supply and ground.
Editable schematic and fully placed and routed PCB are supplied with readable entry files and a README documenting component choices and unresolved requirements.
Header pitch, passive packages, component pin mapping, silkscreen, board containment, copper clearance, trace widths, and complete routing satisfy the common prompt requirements.
